note: Spec 1 /2 closure. /2 documents carry the same fields as /1; the only semantic change is the strict equity ticker and the closed-charset masked label. Every reject is single-cause and names the exact message both languages emit. frozen_weakness entries are ACCEPTED by the frozen /1 validator and REFUSED by /2. Chain cases pass every version-blind check, so the executable gate's version rule is their only possible refusal. Pure ASCII: non-ASCII values are JSON escapes.
